head: Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo add more than 30 new features
dek: Expedia Group rolled out over 30 features across its three apps, including Expedia's AI Activity Planner, which finds and books activities, restaurants and events around your trip.
details: Expedia also adds a Property Expert that answers questions about a hotel, a personal home page, flexible packages and airport perks like Clear Plus discounts and lounge access when flights are delayed. Hotels.com's home page adapts to your trip type, and Vrbo adds a tool for group bookings.
means: If you book holiday travel with these apps, you'll find new AI helpers once a trip is booked.
todo: Update the apps before your next booking.
